An experiment in query execution

Does GPU-accelerated Spark beat Polars?

A bounded comparison of CPU Polars, CPU Spark, and Spark with a GPU plugin on one A100 host.

The original six-query baseline finds no overall GPU Spark win over Polars through SF300 on one A100 host. This result applies to the measured workload and configuration.

Scope & methods

The machine

The software

Incident documentation pending

Method incident

Excluded from performance comparisons

Each engine reads the same generated Parquet inputs under a preheated filesystem policy, without an application DataFrame cache. Preheating does not guarantee that every page stays resident. Query timings include construction, optimization, reads, execution and collected results; startup and setup are excluded.

The original six queries already contain four join queries: Q03, Q10, Q12 and Q14. The complex suite is evaluated separately. Monetary and quantity inputs use Float64/DOUBLE arithmetic, with tolerance-checked parallel reductions. These are selected, non-certified TPC-H-derived workloads.
